DPA

2025-05-27

Divergence Point Analysis on Eye-tracking Data

This R script generates time-course plots of mean fixation proportion, and performs a statistical analysis to determine divergence points between fixations on different objects. It is adapted from the R script in the paper “Analyzing data from the psycholinguistic visual‑world paradigm: Comparison of different analysis methods”, Ito & Knoeferle (2023).

The columns in the original eye-tracking data set are:

  • TOI: trial of interest. There are 48 trials in Version A and 48 trials in Version B.

  • Participant: the code for a participant. There are 32 participants in total; half the participants were assigned to Version A trials and half were assigned to Version B trials.

  • Timeline: the version of the experiment

  • Bin: the number of the time bin for one participant and trial

  • Bin_duration: the duration of each time bin

  • Competitor: binomially coded fixation data - 1=fixation on competitor object in the current time bin; 0=fixation elsewhere

  • Distractor: binomially coded fixation data - 1=fixation on distractor object in the current time bin; 0=fixation elsewhere

  • Target: binomially coded fixation data - 1=fixation on target object in the current time bin; 0=fixation elsewhere

  • TimeMS: the time bin converted to time in milliseconds

  • Animacy_C: the animacy of the competitor noun

  • Animacy_D: the animacy of the distractor noun

  • Animacy_T: the animacy of the target noun

  • Determiner: the type of determiner in the trial (Definite or Possessive)

  • N_Gender_C: the lexical gender of the competitor noun (Masculine or Feminine)

  • N_Gender_D: the lexical gender of the distractor noun (Masculine or Feminine)

  • N_Gender_T: the lexical gender of the target noun (Masculine or Feminine)

  • Phonol_Overlap_C: whether the competitor noun has a minimal pair that only differs in the word-final vowel and lexical gender

  • Phonol_Overlap_D: whether the distractor noun has a minimal pair that only differs in the word-final vowel and lexical gender

  • Phonol_Overlap_T: whether the target noun has a minimal pair that only differs in the word-final vowel and lexical gender

  • ArticleOnset: the onset time (in milliseconds) of the determiner in the audio cue of the current trial

  • NounOnset: the onset time (in milliseconds) of the noun in the audio cue of the current trial

  • EndingOnset: the onset time (in milliseconds) of the noun’s final vowel in the audio cue of the current trial

  • EndingOffset: the offset time (in milliseconds) of the noun’s final vowel in the audio cue of the current trial

  • Remaining: the remaining time after the offset of the audio cue of the current trial

  • SpeakerType: the bilingual status of participant - 1 (Adult Spanish Immigrant) or 2 (Heritage Spanish Speaker)

  • Sex: the sex of the participant (Femenino or Masculino)

  • Age: the age of the participant

  • Position: the position of the object in fixation (top left, bottom centre, top right)

  • Trackloss: whether the fixation is in blank space or off screen, or there is a blink in the current time bin (TRUE or FALSE)

  • TimeMS_adjusted: TimeMS zeroed at ArticleOnset

  • ArticleOnset_adjusted: ArticleOnset zeroed at ArticleOnset (thus always 0)

  • NounOnset_adjusted: NounOnset zeroed at ArticleOnset

  • EndingOnset_adjusted: EndingOnset zeroed at ArticleOnset

  • EndingOffset_adjusted: EndingOffset zeroed at ArticleOnset

  • Remaining_adjusted: Remaining zeroed at ArticleOnset

Define constants

# Window of interest (in milliseconds)
WINDOW_START <- -300
WINDOW_END <- 2000

# Number of pseudobins for normalization
N_PBINS = 100

# Number of consecutive statistically significant time bins required to establish divergence
Nbins = 20

# Number of bootstrap iterations
Niter = 100L

Examine which participants did which trials

pt_matrix <- fix.dat %>%
  distinct(Participant, TOI) %>%
  mutate(did_trial = 1) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = TOI,
    values_from = did_trial,
    values_fill = 0
  )

pt_matrix

Fill in the missing time points and add a trackloss column

# Step 1: Create complete time series based on the window of interest
# If we want all the possible time bins instead, we use min(fix.dat$TimeMS_adjusted) and max(fix.dat$TimeMS_adjusted)

all_times <- seq(
  WINDOW_START,
  WINDOW_END,
  by = 10
)

# Step 2: record the participant-trial pairs that actually occurred in the raw data
observed_combos <- fix.dat %>%
  distinct(Participant, TOI)

# Step 3: fill in the missing time points for those participant-trial combos
full_template <- observed_combos %>%
  tidyr::expand(
    tidyr::nesting(Participant, TOI),
    TimeMS_adjusted = all_times,
    Trackloss = TRUE
  )

# Step 4: left-join raw data onto the template
fix.dat.full <- full_template %>%
  left_join(fix.dat, by = c("Participant", "TOI", "TimeMS_adjusted")) %>%
  select(-Trackloss.y) %>%
  rename(Trackloss = Trackloss.x)

Build a trial info table

# TODO could add other trial variables as needed - if we are comparing by those variables
trial_info <- fix.dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(Determiner)) %>%
  group_by(TOI) %>%
  summarise(
    Determiner = unique(Determiner),
    # TODO don't think SpeakerType should be included in trial_info - it's not a property of a trial
    # SpeakerType = first(SpeakerType),
    NounOnset_adjusted = unique(NounOnset_adjusted),
    EndingOffset_adjusted = unique(EndingOffset_adjusted),
    Phonol_Overlap_T = unique(Phonol_Overlap_T),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# To save as a tab-delimited file (.txt)
write.table(trial_info, file = "trial_info.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE)

Build a participant info table

# TODO could add other trial variables here too - such as age, gender
participant_info <- fix.dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(SpeakerType)) %>%
  group_by(Participant) %>%
  summarise(
    SpeakerType = unique(SpeakerType),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Fill in missing information

# Merge it in and fill NAs
fix.dat.full <- fix.dat.full %>%
  left_join(trial_info, by = "TOI", suffix = c("", ".trial")) %>%
  left_join(participant_info, by = "Participant", suffix = c("", ".participant")) %>%
  mutate(
    # fill AOI and Trackloss columns
    Trackloss  = ifelse(is.na(Trackloss), 1, Trackloss),
    Target     = ifelse(is.na(Target), 0, Target),
    Competitor = ifelse(is.na(Competitor), 0, Competitor),
    Distractor = ifelse(is.na(Distractor), 0, Distractor),
    
    # fill participant- and trial-level values
    SpeakerType = coalesce(SpeakerType, SpeakerType.participant),
    Determiner = coalesce(Determiner, Determiner.trial),
    NounOnset_adjusted = coalesce(NounOnset_adjusted, NounOnset_adjusted.trial),
    EndingOffset_adjusted = coalesce(EndingOffset_adjusted, EndingOffset_adjusted.trial),
    Phonol_Overlap_T = coalesce(Phonol_Overlap_T, Phonol_Overlap_T.trial)
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("SpeakerType.trial",
                   "Determiner.trial", 
                   "NounOnset_adjusted.trial", 
                   "EndingOffset_adjusted.trial",
                   "Phonol_Overlap_T.trial")))

Sanity checks

# Check that everyone now has the right number of bins
fix.dat.full %>%
  group_by(Participant, TOI) %>%
  summarise(n_bins = n()) %>%
  summarise(
    n_missing = sum(n_bins != 171),
    mean_bins = mean(n_bins)
  ) %>%
  print(n=32)

# Check the time range
range(fix.dat.full$TimeMS_adjusted)
# [1] -2670  4750 (if we select the full time range)

# Check a participant-trial pair where timepoints were formerly missing
fix.dat.full %>%
  filter(Participant == "TA106", TOI == "Trial01-def-campesina_0") %>%
  summarise(min_time = min(TimeMS_adjusted), max_time = max(TimeMS_adjusted))

# Check a participant-trial pair that's not supposed to be there (to make sure we didn't invent anything)
fix.dat.full %>%
  filter(Participant == "TA105", TOI == "Trial01-pos-campesina_0") %>%
  summarise(min_time = min(TimeMS_adjusted), max_time = max(TimeMS_adjusted))
# Should return Inf and -Inf

Change TOI and Participant and variables to factor, and drop extra columns

fix.dat.full = fix.dat.full %>% mutate_at(vars(TOI, Participant, Determiner, SpeakerType, Phonol_Overlap_T, Target, Competitor, Distractor), as.factor)

fix.dat.full <- fix.dat.full %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Participant,
    TOI,
    TimeMS_adjusted,
    SpeakerType,
    Determiner,
    Phonol_Overlap_T,
    Target,
    Competitor,
    Distractor,
    NounOnset_adjusted,
    EndingOffset_adjusted
  )

# Collapse the `Non Minimal Pair` levels
fix.dat.full <- fix.dat.full %>%
  mutate(
    Phonol_Overlap_T = forcats::fct_collapse(
      Phonol_Overlap_T,
      "Non Minimal Pair" = c("First Syll-stressed",
                             "First Syll-unstressed")
    )
  )

Sanity check plot (step function plot for one participant and TOI)

trial_id <- "Trial02-def-perro_0"
participant_id <- "TA105"

df_plot <- fix.dat.full %>%
  filter(Participant == participant_id, TOI == trial_id) %>%
  select(TimeMS_adjusted, Target, Competitor, Distractor) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Target, Competitor, Distractor),
               names_to = "AOI", values_to = "Fixation")

library(ggplot2)

vline_df <- tibble::tibble(
  time = c(108, 551),
  event = c("Noun onset", "Ending offset")
)

ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = TimeMS_adjusted, y = Fixation, color = AOI)) +
  geom_step(size = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(
    data = vline_df,
    aes(xintercept=time, linetype=event),
    color="black",
    linewidth=0.8
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(WINDOW_START, WINDOW_END)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Binary Fixations by AOI",
       subtitle = "Participant TA105 – Trial02-def-perro_0",
       x = "Time (ms)",
       y = "Fixated (0/1)") +
  theme_minimal()

fix.dat.full %>%

Reshape binomially encoded fixation data to a long format for plotting and analysis

In the original experiment, the eyetracker takes 25 samples in each 50ms bin, and records the proportion of samples that fall in each AOI. Our eyetracker takes 1 sample in each 10ms bin, and records which AOI the sample falls in (we already removed the trackloss bins, so the sample must be in one of the 3 AOIs, and binomially encoded as 0 or 1). Update actually, now that we added the missing rows back in, there could be rows where FixP=0 in all 3 columns And the pivoted data should be fine after normalization - we’ll just have rows with more than 1 non-zero AOI columns

fix.long <- fix.dat.full %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Target, Competitor, Distractor),
    names_to = "AOI",
    values_to = "FixP"
  )

2. Normalization

Reduce the dataset to two variables: combine Competitor and Distractor to create a NonTarget column

fix.dat.full <- fix.dat.full %>%
  mutate(
    AreaFixated = case_when(
      Target == 1 ~ "Target",
      Competitor == 1 ~ "Competitor",
      Distractor == 1 ~ "Distractor",
      TRUE ~ "Trackloss"
    )
  )

# fix.twovar <- fix.dat.full %>%
#   mutate(NonTarget = Competitor + Distractor) %>%
#   select(-Competitor, -Distractor)

fix.twovar <- fix.dat.full %>%
  mutate(Trackloss = ifelse(AreaFixated == "Trackloss", TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  # mutate(NonTarget = ifelse(AreaFixated == "Target", 0, 1)) %>% # right now, we're have NonTarget as 1 when the fixation is on competitor, distractor or when it's trackloss 
  mutate(NonTarget = as.integer(AreaFixated %in% c("Competitor", "Distractor"))) %>% # alternative version: exclude trackloss in nontarget (so only competitor and distractor)
  mutate(AreaFixated = ifelse(AreaFixated == "Target", "Target", "NonTarget"))

fix.twovar$NonTarget <- as.factor(fix.twovar$NonTarget)
fix.twovar$AreaFixated <- as.factor(fix.twovar$AreaFixated)
# TODO right now we are NOT distinguishing between NonTarget and Trackloss

Pivot binomially encoded columns

fix.twovar <- fix.twovar %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Target, NonTarget),
    names_to = "AOI",
    values_to = "FixP"
  )

fix.twovar = fix.twovar %>% mutate_at(vars(AOI), as.factor)

Create one step function per Participant × AOI × TOI

# Make sure FixP is not a factor
fix.twovar <- fix.twovar %>%
  mutate(FixP = as.numeric(as.character(FixP)))

step_functions <- fix.twovar %>%
  group_by(Participant, AOI, TOI) %>%
  summarise(
    f = list(approxfun(
      x = TimeMS_adjusted,
      y = FixP,
      method = "constant",
      rule = 2
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Plot the step function for one participant-trial

step_functions_example = step_functions %>% filter(Participant == "TA106", TOI == "Trial01-def-campesina_0") 

time_grid <- seq(WINDOW_START, WINDOW_END, by = 10)

library(purrr)

plot_df <- step_functions_example %>%
  mutate(
    data = map(f, ~ tibble(
      TimeMS_adjusted = time_grid,
      FixP = .x(time_grid)
    ))
  ) %>%
  unnest(data)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(TimeMS_adjusted, FixP, colour = AOI)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1) +

Calculate the proportion of trackloss for each trial

library(dplyr)

trackloss_summary <- fix.dat.full %>%
  
  # mark trackloss rows
  mutate(trackloss = AreaFixated == "Trackloss") %>%
  
  # classify time window
  mutate(window = case_when(
    TimeMS_adjusted >= 0 & TimeMS_adjusted < NounOnset_adjusted ~ "determiner_portion",
    TimeMS_adjusted >= NounOnset_adjusted & TimeMS_adjusted <= EndingOffset_adjusted ~ "noun_portion",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  
  # keep only relevant time bins
  filter(!is.na(window)) %>%
  
  # compute proportion
  group_by(Participant, TOI, window) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_trackloss = mean(trackloss),
    n_samples = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

avg_trackloss <- trackloss_summary %>%
  group_by(window) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_prop_trackloss = mean(prop_trackloss),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Normalization for determiner portion

Define windows for each trial

# Compute trial-specific windows
trial_windows_det <- fix.twovar %>%
  group_by(TOI) %>%
  summarise(
    SpeakerType = first(SpeakerType),
    Determiner  = first(Determiner),
    Phonol_Overlap_T = first(Phonol_Overlap_T),
    start_anchor = 0,
    end_anchor   = max(NounOnset_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    window_list = map2(start_anchor, end_anchor, function(start, end) {
      edges <- seq(start, end, length.out = N_PBINS + 1)
      tibble(start = head(edges, -1), end = tail(edges, -1))
    })
  ) %>%
  unnest(window_list)

Compute AUCs for all step functions

auc_trial_windows_det <- step_functions %>%
  left_join(trial_windows_det, by = "TOI", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(
    AUC = pmap_dbl(
      list(f, start, end),
      function(fun, start, end) {
        tryCatch(
          integrate(fun, lower = start, upper = end)$value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      }
    ),
    WindowDur = end - start,
    AUC_prop = AUC / WindowDur
  )

Add pseudo-bin numbers

auc_trial_windows_det <- auc_trial_windows_det %>%
  group_by(Participant, TOI, SpeakerType, Determiner, Phonol_Overlap_T) %>%
  arrange(start, AOI, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(PBin = rep(1:N_PBINS, each = length(unique(AOI)), length.out = n())) %>%
  ungroup()

Compute average AUCs across conditions (for smooth plotting)

auc_summary_det <- auc_trial_windows_det %>%
  group_by(AOI, PBin, SpeakerType, Determiner, Phonol_Overlap_T) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_AUC = mean(AUC, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_AUC = sd(AUC, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    mean_AUC_prop = mean(AUC_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_AUC_prop = sd(AUC_prop, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Plot the summary of AUC proportions across trials and participants

ggplot(auc_summary_det, aes(x = PBin, y = mean_AUC_prop, color = AOI, group = AOI)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_AUC_prop - se_AUC_prop, ymax = mean_AUC_prop + se_AUC_prop, fill = AOI),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Target" = "#ffac00", "NonTarget" = "#002e65")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Target" = "#ffac00", "NonTarget" = "#002e65")) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean AUC over Time for Determiners",
    x = "Pseudo-bin",
    y = "AUC proportions",
    color = "AOI",
    fill = "AOI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)

Normalization for noun portions

Define windows for each trial

trial_windows_noun <- fix.twovar %>%
  group_by(TOI) %>%
  summarise(
    SpeakerType = first(SpeakerType),
    Determiner  = first(Determiner),
    Phonol_Overlap_T = first(Phonol_Overlap_T),
    start_anchor = min(NounOnset_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE),
    end_anchor   = max(EndingOffset_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    window_list = map2(start_anchor, end_anchor, function(start, end) {
      edges <- seq(start, end, length.out = N_PBINS + 1)
      tibble(start = head(edges, -1), end = tail(edges, -1))
    })
  ) %>%
  unnest(window_list)

Compute AUCs for all step functions

auc_trial_windows_noun <- step_functions %>%
  left_join(trial_windows_noun, by = "TOI", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(
    AUC = pmap_dbl(
      list(f, start, end),
      function(fun, start, end) {
        tryCatch(
          integrate(fun, lower = start, upper = end)$value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      }
    ),
    WindowDur = end - start,
    AUC_prop = AUC / WindowDur
  )

Add pseudo-bin numbers

auc_trial_windows_noun <- auc_trial_windows_noun %>%
  group_by(Participant, TOI, SpeakerType, Determiner, Phonol_Overlap_T) %>%
  arrange(start, AOI, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(PBin = rep(1:N_PBINS, each = length(unique(AOI)), length.out = n()) + N_PBINS) %>%
  ungroup()

Compute average AUCs across conditions (for smooth plotting)

auc_summary_noun <- auc_trial_windows_noun %>%
  group_by(AOI, PBin, SpeakerType, Determiner, Phonol_Overlap_T) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_AUC = mean(AUC, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_AUC = sd(AUC, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    mean_AUC_prop = mean(AUC_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_AUC_prop = sd(AUC_prop, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Plot the summary of AUC proportions across trials and participants

ggplot(auc_summary_noun, aes(x = PBin, y = mean_AUC_prop, color = AOI, group = AOI)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_AUC_prop - se_AUC_prop, ymax = mean_AUC_prop + se_AUC_prop, fill = AOI),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Target" = "gold", "NonTarget" = "gray")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Target" = "gold", "NonTarget" = "gray")) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean AUC over Time for Nouns",
    x = "Pseudo-bin",
    y = "AUC proportions",
    color = "AOI",
    fill = "AOI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)

Concatenate the normalized time series for determiners and nouns before taking the average across participants and trials

auc_combined_raw <- bind_rows(auc_trial_windows_det, auc_trial_windows_noun)

Tacking on the remainder

fix.twovar_post <- fix.twovar %>%
  group_by(Participant, TOI) %>%
  
  # keep only the 0–700 ms window after ending offset
  filter(
    TimeMS_adjusted >= EndingOffset_adjusted,
    TimeMS_adjusted <= EndingOffset_adjusted + 700
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    PBin = ((TimeMS_adjusted - min(TimeMS_adjusted)) / 10) + 1 + N_PBINS*2
  ) %>%
  
  ungroup()

fix.twovar.notrackloss <- fix.twovar_post %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Trackloss)

fix.means.twovar = Rmisc::summarySE(fix.twovar.notrackloss, measurevar='FixP', groupvars=c('PBin','SpeakerType', 'AOI', 'Determiner', 'Phonol_Overlap_T'), na.rm=T)

fix.means.twovar <- fix.means.twovar %>%
  rename(mean_AUC_prop = FixP)

summary(fix.means.twovar)

3. Plotting

Concatenate the plots for normalized determiner portions and noun portions

# Combine determiner + noun windows
auc_combined <- bind_rows(
  auc_summary_det,
  auc_summary_noun,
  fix.means.twovar
)

# Make sure grouping vars are factors
auc_combined <- auc_combined %>%
  mutate(
    SpeakerType = as.factor(SpeakerType),
    Determiner = as.factor(Determiner),
    Phonol_Overlap_T = as.factor(Phonol_Overlap_T)
  )

# Plot
auc_plot <- ggplot(
  auc_combined,
  aes(
    x = PBin,
    y = mean_AUC_prop,
    color = AOI,
    group = AOI
  )
) +

  # 8 panels now
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Determiner + SpeakerType + Phonol_Overlap_T,
    ncol = 4,
    labeller = labeller(
      Determiner = c(
        "Definite" = "Definite determiner",
        "Possessive" = "Possessive determiner"
      ),
      SpeakerType = c(
        "1" = "ASI",
        "2" = "HSS"
      ),
      Phonol_Overlap_T = c(
        "Minimal Pair" = "Minimal Pair",
        "NonMinPair" = "Non Minimal Pair"
      )
    )
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  # Line
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +

  # SE ribbon
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_AUC_prop - se_AUC_prop,
      ymax = mean_AUC_prop + se_AUC_prop,
      fill = AOI
    ),
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = NA
  ) +

  # Vertical line at noun onset
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = N_PBINS,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # Vertical line at noun offset
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = N_PBINS * 2,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = N_PBINS,
    y = 0.72,
    label = "Noun onset",
    angle = 90,
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 5
  ) +
  
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = N_PBINS * 2,
    y = 0.72,
    label = "Noun offset",
    angle = 90,
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 5
  ) +
  
  # Horizontal reference lines
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(0.33, 0.67),
    color = "gray75",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    linetype = "solid"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Target" = "gold",
      "NonTarget" = "gray"
    )
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Target" = "gold",
      "NonTarget" = "gray"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Mean Fixation Proportion over Time: Determiner → Noun → Remainder",
    x = "Pseudo-bin (normalized time)",
    y = "Fixation proportion",
    color = "AOI",
    fill = "AOI"
  ) +

  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

auc_plot

                "NonMinPair" = "Non Minimal Pair"
              )
            )
             ) + theme_bw() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data=fix.means.phonol,aes(x=TimeMS_adjusted, y=FixP, group=AOI, colour=AOI, lty=AOI), lwd=1.5) + # TODO use SE or CI here?
  geom_ribbon(data=fix.means.phonol,aes(x=TimeMS_adjusted,ymin=FixP-se,ymax=FixP+se,color=AOI,fill=AOI), linewidth=.2, alpha=.3, lty="dashed", show.legend=F)  +
  labs(y="Fixation Proportion", x="Time relative to the target word onset (ms)") + 
  
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-300, 1400),expand=c(0,0),breaks=seq(-300, 1400, 200)) +
  scale_color_manual('AOI', values=c("#af2013","#002e65","#ffac00")) +
  scale_fill_manual('AOI', values=c("#af2013","#002e65","#ffac00")) +
  scale_linetype_manual('AOI', values=c("solid","dotted", "dotdash")) +
  
  theme(
    text=element_text(size=20),
    legend.key.height=unit(.3,"in"),
    legend.key.width=unit(.6,"in"),
    panel.spacing=unit(1, "in")) 

fix.plot.phonol
Save the plot

4. DPA

Here we will run a by-participant analysis testing the divergence between the Target and NonTarget AOIs. The conditions are SpeakerType and Determiner.

Create stratification variables

Previously we selected a time window; now it will be the normalized and concatenated determine and noun portions. Now the pseudo-bin numbers will act like the previous time bin numbers TimeMS_adjusted ; FixP will become AUC_prop.

# TODO can't use auc_combined because it takes the average of FixP over all participants and trials
div.dat = auc_combined_raw %>%  
  dplyr::mutate(StrataVars=paste(Participant, AOI, PBin, sep='')) %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(SpeakerType, StrataVars),as.factor) %>% 
  droplevels()

summary(div.dat)

head(div.dat)
## # A tibble: 6 × 16
##   Participant AOI       TOI        f     SpeakerType Determiner Phonol_Overlap_T
##   <fct>       <fct>     <fct>      <lis> <fct>       <fct>      <fct>           
## 1 TA105       NonTarget Trial01-d… <fn>  1           Definite   Minimal Pair    
## 2 TA105       Target    Trial01-d… <fn>  1           Definite   Minimal Pair    
## 3 TA105       NonTarget Trial01-d… <fn>  1           Definite   Minimal Pair    
## 4 TA105       Target    Trial01-d… <fn>  1           Definite   Minimal Pair    
## 5 TA105       NonTarget Trial01-d… <fn>  1           Definite   Minimal Pair    
## 6 TA105       Target    Trial01-d… <fn>  1           Definite   Minimal Pair    
## # ℹ 9 more variables: start_anchor <dbl>, end_anchor <dbl>, start <dbl>,

## #   StrataVars <fct>

Rename columns so we don’t have to change the original DPA code

div.dat <- div.dat %>%
  rename(
    TimeMS_adjusted = PBin,
    FixP = AUC_prop
  )

Create two subsets based on the type of determiner

div.dat.def <- div.dat %>% filter(Determiner == "Definite")
div.dat.pos <- div.dat %>% filter(Determiner == "Possessive")

Define bootstrap functions to compute a divergence point for the target vs. unrelated conditions

Bootstrap function using lmer (this should be where the error occurred)

boot_L1L2_lmer = function(original_data, resample_indices){
  dat = original_data[resample_indices, ]
  
  # a statistical test at each timepoint for each group
  test_g1 = dat %>% # t-test for L1 group
    subset(SpeakerType == 1) %>% group_by(TimeMS_adjusted) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(t = summary(lmer(FixP ~ AOI + (1|Participant)))$coefficients["AOITarget", "t value"])

  test_g2 = dat %>% # t-test for L2 group
    subset(SpeakerType == 2) %>% group_by(TimeMS_adjusted) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(t = summary(lmer(FixP ~ AOI + (1|Participant)))$coefficients["AOITarget", "t value"])

  # return a TRUE/FALSE vector of significant positive t-scores
  # (positive means more looks to the target than unrelated)
  t_g1 = test_g1$t > 1.96
  t_g2 = test_g2$t > 1.96
  
  # create empty vectors to store onsets
  onset_g1 = onset_g2 = c()
  
  # find the index of the earliest run of sequential TRUEs; threshold is Nbins
  for (i in 1:(length(t_g2)-Nbins)) {
    onset_g1[i] = sum(t_g1[i:(i+Nbins-1)]) == Nbins
    onset_g2[i] = sum(t_g2[i:(i+Nbins-1)]) == Nbins
  }
  
  # find the difference between onsets
  delta_g1g2 = which(onset_g2)[1] - which(onset_g1)[1]
  
  # print 
  # note: the bootstrap returns the indices of the respective timepoints, not absolute times. 
  # The annotations to the right of each index (e.g. t[,1]) indicate where in the boot object the bootstrapped onset distributions can be found.
  c(delta_g1g2,         # onset difference L1 vs. L2 t[,1]
    which(onset_g1)[1], # onset bin for looks to target L1 t[,2]
    which(onset_g2)[1])  # onset bin for looks to target L2 t[,3]
}

Run the lmer bootstrap on the two subsets by determiner type

bootres_L1L2_lmer_def = boot::boot(
  data = div.dat.def,  # data set to bootstrap       
  statistic = boot_L1L2_lmer,  # bootstrap function      
  strata = div.dat.def$StrataVars, # stratification variable 
  R = Niter)  # number of iterations

bootres_L1L2_lmer_pos = boot::boot(
  data = div.dat.pos,  # data set to bootstrap       
  statistic = boot_L1L2_lmer,  # bootstrap function      
  strata = div.dat.pos$StrataVars, # stratification variable 
  R = Niter)  # number of iterations

bootres_L1L2_lmer_def
bootres_L1L2_lmer_pos

Save the lmer results

save(bootres_L1L2_lmer_def, file="DPA_results.lmer.def.rds")
save(bootres_L1L2_lmer_pos, file="DPA_results.lmer.pos.rds")
Running the lmer bootstrap by trial

This ended up yielding mostly NAs due to the small sample size.

Define a function that runs the bootstrap function for all the trials

run_boot_per_trial <- function(toi_id, df, Niter = 100, strata_col = "StrataVars") {
  trial_data <- df %>% filter(TOI == toi_id) %>% droplevels()

  boot_result <- boot::boot(
    data = trial_data,
    statistic = boot_L1L2_glm,  # your divergence function
    strata = trial_data[[strata_col]],
    R = Niter
  )

  # Extract metadata from the first row (assuming Determiner etc. are constant per trial)
  trial_info <- trial_data %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    select(TOI, Determiner, Phonol_Overlap, GenderMatch)  # add more if needed

  list(boot = boot_result, info = trial_info)
}

Run the function that runs the bootstrap function

trial_ids <- unique(div.dat$TOI)

# Store both the bootstrap and metadata
boot_trials <- lapply(trial_ids, function(toi) run_boot_per_trial(toi, div.dat, Niter = 100))
names(boot_trials) <- trial_ids

Extract divergence values + metadata into a summary dataframe

# Function to extract means and metadata
extract_div_summary <- function(result) {
  bootres <- result$boot
  info <- result$info

  tibble::tibble(
    TOI = info$TOI,
    Determiner = info$Determiner,
    Phonol_Overlap = info$Phonol_Overlap,
    GenderMatch = info$GenderMatchTarget_D,
    ASI_divergence = mean(bootres$t[,2], na.rm = TRUE) * 10 - 10,
    HSS_divergence = mean(bootres$t[,3], na.rm = TRUE) * 10 - 10
  )
}

# Build summary
div_summary_df <- purrr::map_dfr(boot_trials, extract_div_summary)

Bootstrap function using glm (generalized linear model)

boot_L1L2_glm = function(original_data, resample_indices){
  dat = original_data[resample_indices, ]
  
  # a statistical test at each timepoint for each group
  test_g1 = dat %>% # t-test for L1 group
    subset(SpeakerType == 1) %>% group_by(TimeMS_adjusted) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(t = summary(glm(FixP ~ AOI, family = binomial))$coefficients["AOITarget", "z value"])

  test_g2 = dat %>% # t-test for L2 group
    subset(SpeakerType == 2) %>% group_by(TimeMS_adjusted) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(t = summary(glm(FixP ~ AOI, family = binomial))$coefficients["AOITarget", "z value"])

  # return a TRUE/FALSE vector of significant positive t-scores
  # (positive means more looks to the target than unrelated)
  t_g1 = test_g1$t > 1.96
  t_g2 = test_g2$t > 1.96
  
  # create empty vectors to store onsets
  onset_g1 = onset_g2 = c()
  
  # find the index of the earliest run of sequential TRUEs; threshold is Nbins
  for (i in 1:(length(t_g2)-Nbins)) {
    onset_g1[i] = sum(t_g1[i:(i+Nbins-1)]) == Nbins
    onset_g2[i] = sum(t_g2[i:(i+Nbins-1)]) == Nbins
  }
  
  # find the difference between onsets
  delta_g1g2 = which(onset_g2)[1] - which(onset_g1)[1]
  
  # print 
  # note: the bootstrap returns the indices of the respective timepoints, not absolute times. 
  # The annotations to the right of each index (e.g. t[,1]) indicate where in the boot object the bootstrapped onset distributions can be found.
  c(delta_g1g2,         # onset difference L1 vs. L2 t[,1]
    which(onset_g1)[1], # onset bin for looks to target L1 t[,2]
    which(onset_g2)[1])  # onset bin for looks to target L2 t[,3]
}

Run the glm bootstrap on the two subsets by determiner type

bootres_L1L2_glm_def = boot::boot(
  data = div.dat.def,  # data set to bootstrap       
  statistic = boot_L1L2_glm,  # bootstrap function      
  strata = div.dat.def$StrataVars, # stratification variable 
  R = Niter)  # number of iterations

bootres_L1L2_glm_pos = boot::boot(
  data = div.dat.pos,  # data set to bootstrap       
  statistic = boot_L1L2_glm,  # bootstrap function      
  strata = div.dat.pos$StrataVars, # stratification variable 
  R = Niter)  # number of iterations

bootres_L1L2_glm_def
bootres_L1L2_glm_pos

save(bootres_L1L2_glm_def, file="DPA_results.glm.def.rds")
save(bootres_L1L2_glm_pos, file="DPA_results.glm.pos.rds")

load("DPA_results.lmer.def.rds")
load("DPA_results.lmer.pos.rds")

load("DPA_results.glm.def.rds")

Define function to extract divergence points and confidence intervals from bootstrapping results

get_divergence_ms <- function(bootres, index) {
  # index = 2 for ASI, 3 for HSS
  mean_bin <- mean(bootres$t[, index], na.rm = TRUE)
  ci_bin <- boot::boot.ci(bootres, index = index, type = "perc")$percent[4:5]
  
  mean_ms <- (mean_bin - 1) * 10
  ci_ms <- (ci_bin - 1) * 10
  
  list(mean = mean_ms, ci = ci_ms)
}

Run the function on all the results

# Definite determiner
def_asi <- get_divergence_ms(bootres_L1L2_lmer_def, index = 2)
def_hss <- get_divergence_ms(bootres_L1L2_lmer_def, index = 3)

# Possessive determiner

pos_hss <- get_divergence_ms(bootres_L1L2_lmer_pos, index = 3)

5. Group comparison

We can compute a p-value for the group comparison by creating a bootstrap distribution of the null hypothesis. To do this, we will first pool the original data from both groups, randomly assign group labels, and then estimate a difference in divergence point. We will repeat this many times to obtain a distribution of divergence point that could be expected under the null hypothesis. We will obtain the p-value by calculating the proportion of samples from this null distribution that are larger than the observed difference in divergence point in the empirical data.

Below, we will calculate a p-value for the group comparison (ASI vs. HSS group). We will first define a bootstrap function.

Define the bootstrap function for group comparison (only lmer so far)
boot_L1L2_pval = function(original_data, resample_indices){
  dat_resample = original_data[resample_indices, ] # resample the data
  
  dat = dat_resample %>% 
    group_by(Participant, AOI, TimeMS_adjusted) %>% 
    transform(SpeakerType=sample(SpeakerType,replace=F)) %>% # randomly assign group labels 
    ungroup() #%>% 
  
  # a statistical test at each timepoint for each group
  test_g1 = dat %>% # t-test for L1 group
    subset(SpeakerType == 1) %>% group_by(TimeMS_adjusted) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(t = summary(lmer(FixP ~ AOI + (1|Participant)))$coefficients["AOITarget", "t value"])

  test_g2 = dat %>% # t-test for L2 group
    subset(SpeakerType == 2) %>% group_by(TimeMS_adjusted) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(t = summary(lmer(FixP ~ AOI + (1|Participant)))$coefficients["AOITarget", "t value"])
  
  # return a TRUE/FALSE vector of significant positive t-scores  
  # (positive means more looks to the target than unrelated)
  t_g1 = test_g1$t > 1.96
  t_g2 = test_g2$t > 1.96
  
  # create empty vectors to store onsets
  onset_g1 = onset_g2 = c()
  
  # find the index of the earliest run of 4 sequential TRUEs 
  for (i in 1:(length(t_g2)-Nbins)) { 
    onset_g1[i] = sum(t_g1[i:(i+Nbins-1)]) == Nbins
    onset_g2[i] = sum(t_g2[i:(i+Nbins-1)]) == Nbins
  }
  
  # find the difference between onsets
  delta_g1g2 = which(onset_g2)[1] - which(onset_g1)[1]
  
  # print 
  delta_g1g2  # onset difference L1 vs. L2 t[,1]
}
Run the lmer bootstrap on the two subsets by determiner type
bootres_L1L2_pval_def = boot::boot(
  data = div.dat.def,  # data set to bootstrap       
  statistic = boot_L1L2_pval,  # bootstrap function      
  strata = div.dat.def$StrataVars, # stratification variable 
  R = Niter)  # number of iterations        

bootres_L1L2_pval_pos = boot::boot(
  data = div.dat.pos,  # data set to bootstrap       
  statistic = boot_L1L2_pval,  # bootstrap function      
  strata = div.dat.pos$StrataVars, # stratification variable 
  R = Niter)  # number of iterations   

bootres_L1L2_pval_def
bootres_L1L2_pval_pos
Save the group comparison results
save(bootres_L1L2_pval, file="DPA_results.pval.def.rds")
save(bootres_L1L2_pval, file="DPA_results.pval.pos.rds")
If we already have saved results, we can load them.
load("DPA_results.pval.def.rds")
load("DPA_results.pval.pos.rds")
Compute the p-values
pval.def <- round(mean(bootres_L1L2_pval_def$t[,1]>=bootres_L1L2_lmer_def$t0[1], na.rm=T), 5)        
pval.pos <- round(mean(bootres_L1L2_pval_pos$t[,1]>=bootres_L1L2_lmer_pos$t0[1], na.rm=T), 5)
